newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude, heat ends up, gasoline settles lower.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude, heat ends up, gasoline settles lower.

text.p: NYMEX crude and heating oil eked out slight gains Monday after a day of trade rendered light by the Jewish holiday Yom Kippur, while gasoline continued to exhibit its recent weakness, traders said.
"Gasoline has an image problem," said one trader, noting heating continues to look strong, while crude seems to be in a transitional period characterized by choppy sideways trade.

November crude settled 15 cents higher at $23.37 after bouncing off support at $22.85 after it turned down in morning trade. Gasoline sparked crude's early weakness, with October unleaded ending 1.02 cents off at 60.07 cents a gallon.
